original_text: It should be possible to use this common terminal platform with interfaces, applications and accessories to fulfil specific national railway needs. (I) 7A.1.3 The Shunting radio or a combination of Shunting radio and accessories shall comply with the requirements applicable to the Operational radio modified by the requirements that follow in this section. (M) 7A.2 System components 7A.2.1 The logical architecture of the Shunting radio is illustrated in figure 7A-1. (I)

attribute_scores.rationale: Uses vague terms like 'specific national railway needs' and mixes normative levels ('should be possible' vs 'shall comply').
Omits specific definitions of the national requirements and relies entirely on external, unlinked references ('requirements that follow in this section').
Terminology aligns well with the UIC EIRENE project domain glossary (Shunting radio, Operational radio).
Violates standard syntax by mixing multiple statements and using weak modal verbs ('should be possible') alongside mandatory ones ('shall').
Technically realistic and domain-appropriate for railway telecommunications compliance.
Combines at least three distinct requirements into a single block: terminal platform flexibility, shunting radio compliance, and logical architecture illustration.
Difficult to verify the first sentence due to subjective wording ('specific national railway needs').

evaluations.context_reasoning: The requirement text improperly combines general platform usage goals, standard compliance mandates (Operational radio modification), and structural references to architecture figures into a single paragraph. This violates the principle of singularity and impedes testability.

The use of 'should' is a weak modal verb that undermines the mandatory nature of engineering specifications under ISO/IEC/IEEE 29148. Requirements should employ 'shall' for obligatory system behavior.
The phrase 'specific national railway needs' is ambiguous and open-ended without pointing to a specific appendix, registry, or standard, making verification impossible.

(I) 7A.1.3 The Shunting radio or a combination of Shunting radio and accessories shall comply with the requirements applicable to the Operational radio modified by the requirements that follow in this section. layer3.refined_text: The Shunting radio or a combination of Shunting radio and accessories shall comply with the requirements applicable to the Operational radio as modified by the requirements in this section.
changes_made: Isolated the core compliance requirement and removed bundled extraneous clauses (platform flexibility and figure references) to enforce singularity (DEF-1).
Replaced the weak modal 'should be possible' with the mandatory 'shall comply' (DEF-2).
Removed vague reference to 'specific national railway needs' to eliminate ambiguity while preserving the core Operational radio compliance rule (DEF-3).
layer3.functional_intent_preservation_rationale: The core functional intent of the original requirement mandates that the Shunting radio (or its combination with accessories) must adhere to the Operational radio requirements as modified by the subsequent section rules. By isolating this core compliance rule and applying standard EARS/IEEE syntax ('The Shunting radio or a combination of Shunting radio and accessories shall comply...'), the exact technical obligation is retained while eliminating non-compliant bundled statements, weak modals, and vague terminology.

checks.observations: Successfully separated the core compliance mandate from the bundled platform flexibility and figure reference statements, resolved the weak modal 'should', and removed the vague reference to national needs.
No subjective descriptors, fuzzy bounds, or vague adjectives were introduced in the refined text.
No arbitrary technical specifics, protocols, or out-of-scope rules were added; the text strictly derives from the original compliance clause.
The core functional intent—that Shunting radios and their accessory combinations must comply with Operational radio requirements modified by the section rules—is fully preserved.
Adheres to IEEE 29148 standards using mandatory 'shall' phrasing, active voice, and proper grammatical structure.

layer4.critique_and_feedback: The Layer 3 refinement successfully isolates the primary normative requirement from the multi-part original text, resolving all identified defects (singularity, weak modality, and ambiguity) without violating functional intent or introducing unwarranted assumptions.
